item.description:
A test update to try the update flow
- Nothing changed in Perch: this release only exists to check that updating works - The notch downloads it with a ring beside the camera, then restarts and says Updated - What's new scrolls when the list is long, and a long line like this one wraps instead of being cut off at the edge of the notch - Line four of the test list - Line five of the test list - Line six of the test list - Line seven of the test list: scroll down to see it - Line eight of the test list: and this is the last one

Update Perch from the notch
- Perch updates itself: a ring beside the camera while it downloads, then a small row that says Updated - Check for updates in the menu bar, with Update, Later and What is new - Record your own shortcut to open Perch
